held_out.quote: MBPP+ (974 tasks) was split into 374 training and 500 testing tasks.

cross_task.quote: PPO policies were trained independently for each dataset–backbone configuration

budget_matched.quote: We run Random-Hybrid for 10 refinement steps per task, using the same evaluation protocol as the PPO setting.

improver_comparison.quote: This baseline isolates whether the performance gains come merely from access to the hybrid action space or from learned action scheduling.

evidence_level.quote: Since Random-Hybrid has access to the same transformations as PPO, this result shows that the gains are not explained by the hybrid action sp

S1.quote: The generated program is evaluated against test cases, and the resulting correctness signal defines the reward

S3.quote: All backbone models remain frozen during evaluation

S4.quote: The action space includes three actions: (1) Direct Generation, which preserves the current prompt, (2) genetic algorithm–based lexical mutation inspired by EPiC [ 30 ] , and (3) semantic rewriting inspired by Reflexion [ 29 ] .

S5.quote: PPO policies were trained independently for each dataset–backbone configuration

F2.quote: The proposed framework learns to select between lexical mutation and semantic rewriting based on intermediate test feedback.

ap1.quote: an agent iteratively refines natural language prompts in order to improve the functional correctness of code generated by an LLM
